reason: shadcn's drawer.tsx wraps vaul 1.1.2, a React-only library built on Radix Dialog. The port adds no JavaScript dependency (same policy as sonner): vaul's behavior (Radix Dialog modal layer, drag-to-dismiss, snap points, background scaling) is reimplemented in the chadcn--drawer controller on the shared primitives and vaul's injected stylesheet is shipped verbatim as vaul.css, so the compared DOM, data-vaul-* attributes and computed styles equal the oracle. vaul Root and Radix Portal render no element and closed Overlay/Content are not mounted, so a server-rendered Stimulus port needs one controller host and somewhere to ship the closed markup; neither carries a data-slot, classes or layout. React-only inputs (an HTMLElement container, function callbacks, useId) are mapped to a selector, events and explicit ids.
api: Drawer renders one <div style="display: contents" data-controller="chadcn--drawer"> host with no data-slot, classes or other data attributes besides controller wiring
closed Portal children (Overlay, Content) are server-rendered inside a <template> in the host and mounted into the container (document.body by default) on open
Drawer container: and Drawer::Portal container: are CSS selector strings instead of DOM elements

Drawer takes id: (no vaul/Radix prop): the id of the content, the other generated ids being <id>-<part>; Radix numbers ids with React's useId; the port numbers them per request with the Rails engine and per render otherwise (Chadcn::Sequence)
vaul callbacks onDrag, onRelease, onClose, onAnimationEnd and setActiveSnapPoint are the events chadcn--drawer:drag, :release, :close, :animation-end and :active-snap-point-change
vaul is not a dependency: its behavior lives in chadcn--drawer and its injected stylesheet in app/assets/tailwind/chadcn/vaul.css
